name: flightdeck-review
description: Evidence-bounded code and release readiness review.

interface.longDescription: Audit code, packaging, security, privacy, public claims, reviewer cases, and submission gates without turning missing evidence into a pass. FlightDeck Review returns a clear ship decision, reproducible findings, executed checks, bounded fixes when requested, and every remaining gap.
defaultPrompt: Audit this project for release readiness and report only verified findings.
Review this plugin for marketplace submission, including five positive and three negative reviewer tests.
Make this release candidate ready to ship, then rerun every relevant check.
